name: Tahoma Glacier

waypoints.name: West Side Road gate / Dry Creek Trailhead

approach: From the Westside Road gate at Dry Creek Trailhead: Tahoma Creek Trail to the Wonderland Trail (~5,600 ft), then onto the southern side of the Tahoma Glacier. The park lists the Tahoma Creek Trail as closed — washed out, unmaintained and exposed to debris flows from the glacier — so check current park trail conditions before relying on it.
